tools.name: hyperliquid_carry_spreads
tools.description: The widest funding-rate spreads between Hyperliquid venues right now. The same asset funds at different rates on the native exchange and on builder-deployed venues, and no single Hyperliquid call sees two venues, so this gap cannot be read from the exchange directly. Floored by open interest so every row is tradeable. Call this before opening a funding carry. Paid per call.

tools.name: hyperliquid_funding_board
tools.description: Funding, open interest in dollars and premium for every perp on Hyperliquid across all eleven venues at once, sampled every few minutes. Hyperliquid answers one venue per call; this is all of them. Paid per call.

limit.description: How many assets, largest open interest first. Default 15.

tools.name: hyperliquid_asset
tools.description: One asset across every Hyperliquid venue that lists it: funding, open interest, mark and premium per venue, plus the top-of-book imbalance, which is the only signal here that says which side is crowded. Paid per call.

coin.description: The asset symbol, for example BTC or NVDA.

tools.name: hyperliquid_builder_fees
tools.description: What each Hyperliquid builder actually charges, measured from their own published fills: fills, notional, fee taken and the effective rate in basis points. Free.
